title: Fail closed when page visibility metadata is malformed
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that PageService falls back to the configured default minimum role when page metadata is missing or malformed; the default is Anonymous. Corrupt metadata for a restricted page can therefore downgrade visibility. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Services/PageService.cs lines 530-543. Preserve a load error and fail closed to the most restrictive role with regression tests.
